name: @tokenized/cordova-plugin-ios-permit-getusermedia
description: Cordova plugin allowing getUserMedia camera view without triggering a permission dialog every time

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run validate && npm run check-xml && npm run test-install
scripts.check-xml: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const xml=fs.readFileSync('plugin.xml','utf8'); if(!xml.includes('<plugin')) throw new Error('Invalid plugin.xml'); console.log('plugin.xml is valid')"
scripts.build: npm run format && npm run test
